R1 Hospital passes ('Note saved, but the structured summary couldn't be updated … tap Save Note to retry', text kept, Generate disabled with 'did not finish processing'; clean second Save → '✓ Note saved. Auto-updated: …', Generate enabled). R1 Nursing Home: the failure half passes the same way; after the clean second Save Generate is enabled, but no success message is visible — only the 'Saved 5:02 PM · Oct 14' stamp (its '✓ Auto-updated' line sits inside the collapsed editor) — recorded, not counted as the oracle's success message. R4 Hospital passes ('✓ Note saved. Auto-updated: admission reason, vitals, labs, radiology, hospital course', Generate enabled). R4 Nursing Home: Generate enabled; no success message visible, only 'Saved 5:03 PM · Oct 14' — recorded (the same stamp R2 shows, so Nursing Home gives no success signal at all; whether 'Saved <time>' is the success message needs a decision). TC-10/S26.productIssue: When the summary comes back without background and studies: Hospital shows '✓ Note saved. Auto-updated: vitals, labs, hospital course' and restamps the background panel 'Updated 5:02 PM · Oct 14' directly under yesterday's one-liner 'Admitted with community-acquired pneumonia, improving on IV antibiotics.' (usePreRoundProcess.ts:394 sets admissionSummary.lastUpdatedAt = now even when no background came back), with yesterday's study 'Chest X-ray: right lower lobe infiltrate' still on the panel — so yesterday's text is labelled as updated today. Nursing Home shows only the 'Saved <time>' stamp, identical to a full success (its lastUpdatedAt is restamped too), so nothing tells the physician the panels were not refreshed. Breaks TC-10 U6 literal ('yesterday's panels are never silently reused'); whether a notice naming them is enough is Q14. Also for Daniela: Nursing Home Save Note shows no success message in any outcome (R1 retry, R4) — is 'Saved <time>' the success message?
